text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Huh... Rework the entire plan...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Our greatest obstacle in aiming for 
first place in the booth contest is the 
Student Council's booth led by President 
Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The other day, I happened to catch a 
glimpse of their preparations—or rather, 
their rehearsal. 
Their project is a "Theatrical Cafe"...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The production is a dream three-way clash 
among Triple Crown horsegirls— 
It's a visually spectacular project that 
precisely identifies and appeals to fan 
demand.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
To compete against that, our concept cafe 
is still lacking polish.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...So you're saying we need to brush up 
our worldbuilding and presentation to 
better meet the fans' expectations... is 
that it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Precisely. For now, I will work on 
drafting a proposal, so continue with the 
current preparations while you wait for—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, apologies. I have student council 
duties to attend to after this... 
In any case, that's the plan. I'm counting 
on you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If we lean into roleplay elements like 
masters and maids or butlers... 
I can't compromise Alve or Dura's 
character image too much either...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(—! It's already 6:00 PM... The delivery 
of drinks and dry ingredients is scheduled 
for right about now. I'm worried about 
space in the storage room too, so I must 
oversee it personally.)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Right... I need to hurry.

text_block_list.name: Student Council Officer
text_block_list.text:
Madam Vice President, there's something we 
need to discuss with you—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What is it? Tell me first.

text_block_list.name: Student Council Officer
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, well... the arch contractor's 
truck got a flat tire and is stranded 
along the riverbank... We wanted to 
discuss adjusting the schedule...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Then I'll go drag the truck here 
myself. 
Wait by the front gate.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm taking a nap. 
Making a racket in here is getting in my 
way. Get out.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
How selfish can you be...! 
I need to check the equipment here. If you 
want to nap, go somewhere else—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The vendor delivered exactly what was on 
the invoice. There's nothing to check. 
Just get out.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Um... what did you want to talk about? So 
suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: At this rate, it'll be far too easy.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The "Emperor," and I as well—we're going 
to crush the "Empress" with everything 
we've got.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
No holding back. No mercy. 
...Even if our opponent has pushed herself 
so hard she's lost her way.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I've got no time for a boring fight.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Pushed herself so hard... she's lost 
her way...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Aren't you being awful kind today, Brian?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that you're worried about Air 
Groove 
overworking herself lately? No... more 
precisely...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You want to make sure she can focus on her 
own booth and perform at her best, right? 
Since it's a rare chance to compete, you 
want to enjoy it with everything on the 
line.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I agree, Brian. 
I want to meet an Air Groove who is 
fighting with every fiber of her being at 
full strength.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
..."Meet her," huh? 
——Ha. Naive as ever, Lady "Emperor."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
What I'm waiting for is her awakening. 
She's——

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"As expected of President Rudolf... She 
always sees things from such a high 
perspective. 
It frustrates me, but I didn't think that 
far ahead this time."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "...All you ever do is look up to her."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"True... But that is precisely why it 
fuels my fire. 
It is because she stands on such high 
ground that she is worth taking down!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(No matter how formidable the "Emperor" 
is, 
she won't just fall in line. She won't 
stay beneath her. She'll evolve to surpass 
her.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...That's why she's worth sinking my teeth 
into.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The "Empress" can evolve in any way 
imaginable.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You'd better stay on your guard. Against 
the "Empress," and against me.
